text: “Just then the crowd lapped them up and closed them in, and I saw no more, being called by my master, who was in a rage because a joint that the scrivener had ordered was forgot, though I take all the saints to witness that to blame me for that miscarriage were like holding the unborn babe to judgment for sins com--” “Out of my sight, idiot! Thy prating drives me mad! Whither art flying? Canst not bide still an instant? Went they toward Southwark?” “Even so, your worship--for, as I said before, as to that detestable joint, the babe unborn is no whit more blameless than--” “Art here yet!
